name: oh-my-fable
description: Anthropic's prompting-guide rules for Claude Code, always on (Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1; Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 too): install and forget: the working rules load at every session start and reach subagents, unattended sessions are detected automatically and get the early-stop rules, /fable-prompt turns a rough request into a guide-aligned prompt, /fable-status shows what is in effect, /fable-audit scores your own rules against the guides, /fable-setup is optional.
